definitions.explanation: A complete breakdown or failure of something that was functioning, such as a system, relationship, or plan.
The state of being unable to pay debts; financial ruin of a company or individual.

examples.japanese: {論理|ろんり}が{破綻|はたん}している。
{結婚|けっこん}{生活|せいかつ}が{破綻|はたん}した。
{計画|けいかく}の{破綻|はたん}は{避|さ}けられなかった。
examples.english: The failure of the plan was unavoidable.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}した。
{財政|ざいせい}{破綻|はたん}の{危機|きき}に{瀕|ひん}している。
examples.english: We are on the verge of financial collapse.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}の{破綻|はたん}で{預金|よきん}が{凍結|とうけつ}された。
examples.english: Deposits were frozen due to the bank's failure.

notes:
{破綻|はたん} indicates complete failure or collapse.

FORMS:
- {破|は} (break) + {綻|たん} (rip, tear)
- Literally: ripping apart

SENSE 1 (GENERAL FAILURE):
- {論理|ろんり}の{破綻|はたん}: logical flaw
- {関係|かんけい}の{破綻|はたん}: breakdown of a relationship
- {計画|けいかく}の{破綻|はたん}: failure of a plan

SENSE 2 (FINANCIAL):
- {経営|けいえい}{破綻|はたん}: business failure/bankruptcy
- {財政|ざいせい}{破綻|はたん}: fiscal collapse
- {破綻|はたん}する: to go bankrupt, to fail

RELATED WORDS:
- {倒産|とうさん}: bankruptcy (business)
- {崩壊|ほうかい}: collapse (physical/system)
- {頓挫|とんざ}: setback, stalling
